<!-- theorem-1: body_md -->
\label{thm:gauss}
For any graph, any electric field $h$ and any matter state, under motional heating at rates $\dot{n}_m$,
motional dephasing at any rates and qubit dephasing at rate $\gamma_z$ on each link,
\begin{equation}
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} t}\left\langle \hat G_m \right\rangle=-2\dot{n}_m\,\left\langle \hat G_m\,(2\hat n_m+1) \right\rangle-2\gamma_z d_m\left\langle \hat G_m \right\rangle,
\label{eq:gaussode}
\end{equation}
where $d_m$ is the number of links that meet site $m$.
<!-- end theorem-1 -->
<!-- corollary-1: body_md -->
\label{cor:gausscert}
With $N_0$ the initial total phonon number,
\begin{equation}
\big|\left\langle \hat G_m \right\rangle(t)-\left\langle \hat G_m \right\rangle(0)\big|\le
2\dot{n}_m\Big[(2N_0+1)\,t+\tfrac12\Big(\sum_{m'}\dot{n}_{m'}\Big)t^2\Big].
\label{eq:gausscert}
\end{equation}
<!-- end corollary-1 -->
<!-- corollary-2: body_md -->
\label{cor:gausslaw}
Replacing the correlator in Eq.~\eqref{eq:gaussode} by the product of its expectations, and the noisy
population by the noiseless population plus the heating ramp,
\begin{equation}
\left\langle \hat G_m \right\rangle(t)\approx\left\langle \hat G_m \right\rangle(0)\exp\Big[-2\dot{n}_m\int_0^t\big(2\bar{n}_{m_{}}^{(0)}(s)+2\dot{n}_m s+1\big)\mathrm{d} s\Big],
\label{eq:gausslaw}
\end{equation}
where $\bar{n}_{m_{}}^{(0)}(s)$ is the population of mode $m$ under the noiseless dynamics.
<!-- end corollary-2 -->
<!-- theorem-2: body_md -->
\label{thm:flux}
At $h=0$, under motional heating, motional dephasing, qubit dephasing and qubit bit flips at rate $\gamma_x$
per link,
\begin{equation}
\left\langle \hat W_C \right\rangle(t)=\left\langle \hat W_C \right\rangle(0)\,\mathrm{e}^{-2\gamma_x|C|\,t}
\label{eq:fluxlaw}
\end{equation}
exactly. At $h\neq0$ the same expression is the first-order law for the noise-induced factor, and the
noise-induced deviation is certified by $|\Delta\left\langle \hat W_C \right\rangle|\le2\gamma_x|C|\,t$.
<!-- end theorem-2 -->
<!-- theorem-3: body_md -->
\label{thm:wall}
Let the two-link loop be prepared with $\pi$ flux and $h=0$. Under motional heating, motional dephasing and
qubit dephasing at any rates, the zero-flux sector population $\left\langle \hat{\Pi}_{\Phi} \right\rangle$ remains zero and no matter
crosses the loop. Under qubit bit flips at rate $\gamma_x$ per link,
\begin{equation}
\left\langle \hat{\Pi}_{\Phi} \right\rangle(t)=\tfrac12\big(1-\mathrm{e}^{-4\gamma_x t}\big)
\label{eq:leak0}
\end{equation}
exactly, and the population that crosses the loop is bounded by this quantity.
<!-- end theorem-3 -->
<!-- proposition-1: body_md -->
\label{prop:lambda}
For a pure single phonon on the first site and the gauge field in $|\Psi^{+}_{\ell_1\ell_2}\rangle$, the zero-flux sector population
under Eq.~\eqref{eq:H} is
\begin{equation}
P^{\Lambda}_{\Phi}(t)=\frac{h^2}{h^2+J^2}\sin^2\Omega t+\frac{h^2J^2}{(h^2+J^2)^2}\big(1-\cos\Omega t\big)^2 .
\label{eq:lambda}
\end{equation}
<!-- end proposition-1 -->
<!-- theorem-4: body_md -->
\label{thm:wallfield}
Under all noise channels, with the thermal initial matter of the experiment,
\begin{equation}
\left\langle \hat{\Pi}_{\Phi} \right\rangle(t)\le P^{\rm ref}_{\Phi}(t)+w_{\rm rest}+2\gamma_x t
+\tfrac12\int_0^t\sum_m\dot{n}_m\Big[\left\langle \hat n_m \right\rangle+\sqrt{\left\langle \hat n_m^2 \right\rangle}+\left\langle \hat n_m+1 \right\rangle
+\sqrt{\left\langle (\hat n_m+1)^2 \right\rangle}\Big]_{\rm ref}\mathrm{d} s ,
\label{eq:wallcert}
\end{equation}
where every quantity on the right is evaluated on the small-sector reference.
<!-- end theorem-4 -->
